SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well then, first of all...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm counting on you, Saori!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: So it's about Kuroneko-shi's situation...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, do you happen to know anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Let's see... I heard she's busy working on her manuscript for the upcoming Summer Comiket.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: And that's why there won't be any contact for a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see, working on her manuscript for Summer Comiket, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Every year, many circle participants lose sleep just to finish their work in time for this event.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Surely, it's the final stage of preparations.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see...
No wonder Kirino doesn't understand, she never joined a circle to participate before...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: However, after hearing from you, it appears that that's not the case.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You think so too?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: However, that's about all I can say so far.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I'd also like to help Kuroneko-shi with her endeavor, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I too, am very busy. Please accept my deepest apologies...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Are you also bothered by something?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: N-No! I-It's just the so-called 'family matters'.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see... then is there anything I can help with?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: It's all right. Please help Kuroneko-shi instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Got it, leave it to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You have my gratitude, Kyousuke-shi.
Given Saori's personality, it must be rough on her if she's unable to do anything when something happens to her friends... Compared to others, she
really treasures her friends.
Myself, I hate when all I can do is show concern... And yet...
Nonetheless, I can't ask her to do more...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't worry about it. You have to put yourself first.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: It lightens my mood a bit to hear you say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Now that I think about it, isn't Kiririn-shi related to this matter?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: She was feeling down about being ignored by Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: To be honest, I asked Kirino for advice before coming to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Preposterous, you asking Kiririn-shi?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yes, I asked her if I was being overly considerate and now Kuroneko thinks I'm creepy or something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But, from what she said, Kuroneko doesn't mind that at all. That's why she ordered me to resolve it myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I see, I see. I understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Then, there is only one conclusion.
Right, that thing Kirino mentioned, I might as well ask Saori about it too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Say, do you know anything about Kuroneko and any important goal she might have?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Well! I don't really...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see, I thought so...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-shi... Who told you about this "important goal"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It was Kirino...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I see, I see. So that's how it is.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's the matter? Do you happen to know something?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Not at all. Just that, did those words stick to your mind?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah... well, kind of.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Huhuhu...
What's with her weird laughter?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: These matured brain cells of mine are telling me that it would be best to let you handle this situation by yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Seeing as I cannot partake in this, all I can do is make wild guesses.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, well, I guess so...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Then remain as you are and go all out with a bang!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...I'm sure Kuroneko-shi will be delighted if you put your step forward.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't get it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: We'll leave it at here for now. Let's talk about something else.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But regarding Kuroneko...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Now now, maybe you'll agree after listening.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: While it is true that I have stuff to do, I promised Kuroneko-shi to meet her tomorrow.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh? What for?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: We're going to buy art supplies for preparing doujinshi to be sold at Comiket.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: "It would be problematic if you ran out later, so how about going together?" is what I told her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ahah...
As expected from Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: In that case, allow me to go along with you.
This could be a chance for me to speak with Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hehehe, I thought you'd say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yeah, we would love to have you. We'll meet at Akihabara tomorrow then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah! Thanks a lot!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Don't mention it, I'll create the opportunity for you two to talk, so when that happens...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No need to say more! I'll try and make the most use out of it!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You must do your best, Kyousuke-shi, good fortune to you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...All right. Tomorrow is the showdown!
